keywords.description: Words every result holds, in any case.

from.description: Only messages from this person, by name, or `me` for yours.

before.description: Only messages sent before this time, in ISO 8601.

after.description: Only messages sent after this time, in ISO 8601.

is_thread.description: true for thread replies alone, false for none.

limit.description: How many messages to return, 1 to 100; 20 where left out.

cursor.description: The next_cursor a previous read returned, for its next page.

sort.description: `score` (the default) for the best matches first, or `timestamp` for the newest first.

response_format.description: `detailed` (the default) for times and thread info, or `concise` for ids, senders, and words alone.
